item.tib: bskang 'dus kyi mngon rtogs gsal ba'i me long
item.coloph: bskang mdos gnad kyi man ngag mngon rtogs gsal ba'i man ngag 'di/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin chen po yis/ grub gnas dam pa shel le rdzongs (rdzong) drug tu/ dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la/ nges med sprang po bdag la snyan du brgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul nas bris/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyis/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor g.yung drung rgyal po la brgyud pa'o//
